text:
Maya R.: heads-up: two customers hit an opaque 413 from the embeds fastpath splitter. support couldn't advise.
Jessica L.: we should return structured 413s. minimal: `{ code: "embed_oversize", reason: "mixed_dims_or_bytes", hint: "call /v1/embeddings/preflight or enable X-Embed-AutoSplit" }`
Arun P.: runtime note: splitter can fallback to slowpath but clients that fast-fail get immediate 413. Options: change runtime fallback default or improve client ergonomics.
Ryan H.: I'll prototype SDK behavior: on 413 + embed_oversize -> call POST /v1/embeddings/preflight, get split plan, resend chunks. Add opt-in header `X-Embed-AutoSplit: true` and emit `embed.retry_after_split` metric.
Sam K.: console idea: small "Fix 413s" card on route pages when 413 rate spikes. show recommended split, sample curl, and one-click preflight modal.
deploy-bot: canary: embed-splitter:v2 -> us-west-2 (20%).
Jessica L.: spec: add `error.hint_type` values: `preflight`, `dimension_hint`, `bytes_hint`. include `expected_dims` when available and document in changelog.
Arun P.: add header `x-embed-splitter-reason: mixed-dims;preferred_split=1536` so proxies/clients can react without parsing body.
Ryan H.: metrics plan: tag `embed.fastpath.reject_reason` (mixed_dims/bytes/unparsable) + gauge `embed.preflight.offered`. Sam: suggest Grafana: `sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status="413"}[5m])) by (route)` and `ratio(sum(rate(embed_requests_total{status="413"}[5m])), sum(rate(embed_requests_total[5m])))` with drilldown to `embed.fastpath.reject_reason`.
Maya R.: owners & timeline: Ryan -> SDK PR/tests this week; Jessica+Arun -> spec + docs; Sam -> console mock by Friday. I'll open a short support runbook and sync tomorrow 11am. Thanks! :thumbsup:
